note: SIMULATED: every number comes from the PETAL Locate simulator and models with illustrative link parameters and nominal orbital slots (config/pacific-uhf.yaml), not from real satellites, terminals or sites.
method: sim.montecarlo.run_trials: simulated IQ (SimWorld.render_iq) -> caf_estimate -> calibration -> solve for a 20 dBW, 10 kHz noise jammer at the point, pairs by the tasking rule, 1 s captures, draw_errors=True (every trial draws satellite ephemeris, oscillator, site clock and per-pair TDOA bias errors from the configured one-sigma uncertainty, operator-grade or every satellite at TLE-grade; the solver assumes the same sigmas), uncalibrated or calibrated against the configured reference in the jammer's channel. Miss = horizontal distance from the truth; containment = fraction inside the solver's own 95 % ellipse (NEES <= 5.99); mean NEES 2 is ideal.
